indicador.Name: Storyteller indicator
indicador.Hint: Shows a small bar above the macro bar with the Thermometer and the current night (Storyteller only).

vistaNarrador.Name: See the map in dark scenes
vistaNarrador.Hint: With no token selected, the Storyteller sees the scene brightened to read the map. Players still see it dark; select a token to see through its eyes.

importar.titulo: The Ward File: import the chronicle
importar.pregunta: This world doesn't have the chronicle yet. Import The Ward File now (journals, characters, scenes and macros)? You can do it later from the “Import the chronicle” compendium.
importar.actualizarTitulo: The Ward File: update the chronicle
importar.actualizarPregunta: This world's chronicle was imported with version {importada} of the module and you now have {version}. Update it?
importar.actualizarQueSe: the text of the journals, the scenes (map, walls, lights), the macros and the NPC actors with their sheets, as they come in this version.
importar.actualizarQueNo: who can see and who owns each document; the handouts and pages you already revealed; the PCs and every actor owned by a player (left untouched: Hunger, damage, XP and gear stay as they are; only missing ones are created); the pages, items, tokens, drawings and notes you added by hand; the active scene; and the state of the chronicle (Thermometer, clues, night).
importar.actualizarAviso: Anything you changed by hand INSIDE one of the module's documents (the text of a page, an NPC's sheet, a wall) is overwritten by the new version.
importar.sinAventura: I can't find the Adventure in the module's “{pack}” compendium.

idioma.hint: The language of the journals, sheets, scenes and the Panel. Buttons show in each user's Foundry language.

menu.Name: Chronicle language
menu.Label: Choose language
menu.Hint: Imports the chronicle in Spanish or in English. Mid-chronicle, it switches language while keeping the PCs, what you revealed and the state of the chronicle.
menu.sinCronica: This world doesn't have the chronicle yet. Choose the language to import it in.
menu.aviso: Journals, scenes and NPCs are rewritten in the chosen language: anything you changed by hand INSIDE them is lost. Player-owned PCs stay as they are, in their language.

termometro.sinCambio: The Thermometer is already at {valor}: no change.

chat.valor: It stays at {valor}. While frozen, it won't go up or down.
